exposureNotice.title: Security notice
exposureNotice.heading: Your recovery phrases may have been exposed
exposureNotice.whatHappened: Earlier versions of Fearless Wallet for browsers ({first} and {from} to {to}) contained code that sent wallet recovery phrases, the passphrase words that restore a wallet, to an outside server when the wallet was unlocked. For wallets added from a JSON file or a raw seed, it sent the encrypted key together with the wallet password.
exposureNotice.thisVersion: This version does not contain that code.
exposureNotice.whatWeKnow: The wallets listed here were already in this app before this update. The app cannot tell whether their phrases were sent, received or used, so treat each of them as possibly exposed.
exposureNotice.whatItMeans: Whoever holds a recovery phrase can move the funds on every address made from it, at any time. Changing your password does not protect an exposed phrase.
exposureNotice.passwordAdvice: If you use this wallet's password anywhere else, change it there.
exposureNotice.whatToDo: Create a new wallet in this version, back up its new recovery phrase, and move your funds to it one network at a time. The next screen guides you through it.
exposureNotice.enrollmentHold: Until you confirm below, no new network addresses (Bitcoin, Solana, TON, Iroha) are added to these wallets.
exposureNotice.walletRemovedHint: If it still holds funds, add it again with its recovery phrase and move them.
exposureNotice.confirm: I understand that these wallets may be exposed and that a new password does not protect them.
exposureNotice.acknowledgeFailed: Your confirmation could not be saved. Try again.
exposureNotice.reminder: {count} wallet from before this update may be exposed. Move its funds to a new wallet. | {count} wallets from before this update may be exposed. Move their funds to a new wallet.
exposureNotice.receiveWarning: This wallet may be exposed. Receive funds in a wallet created in this version instead.

guide.title: Move to a new wallet
guide.intro: Do these steps in order. Your old wallets stay in the list and keep working. Nothing is deleted.
guide.createText: Create it here, in this version, so that it gets a new recovery phrase. Do not import an old phrase, key or JSON file: the exposure would come with it.
guide.createTonText: TON wallets are separate. Funds in an old TON wallet need a new TON wallet.
guide.backupText: Write its recovery phrase on paper and keep it offline. Without it the new wallet cannot be restored.
guide.backupConfirm: I have written down the new recovery phrase
guide.moveTitle: Move your funds, one network at a time
guide.moveText: Open each old wallet and send every balance it still holds to your new wallet. Each network charges its own fee, so send a network's own coin last.
guide.moveNotListed: Staked funds, liquidity pools and NFTs are not listed here. Unstake or withdraw them first, then send them the same way.
guide.nothingFound: No balance found on the networks shown for this wallet. Check hidden and switched-off networks before you mark it as moved.
guide.remaining: {count} old wallet still to move | {count} old wallets still to move
guide.allMoved: Every old wallet is marked as moved. Keep them in the list until you are sure nothing is left: late payments can still arrive at the old addresses.
